title: RuleReplayReport
description: The result of replaying a RuleCandidate against historical VERIFIED WorkflowTraces and comparing the rule's decision to each trace's verified final_decision. It is the M5 evidence the promotion gate reads: precision, recall, counts of true/false positives and negatives, abstention_rate, and the two SAFETY counters the gate keys on — unsafe_false_positives (a truth-serving rule confidently produced a WRONG served fact) which MUST be 0 for a truth_serving promotion, and tenant_leak_count (the rule used a tenant_private trace to decide a global case) which MUST be 0 always. Replay runs ONLY over verified traces (replayed_over_verified_only pinned true). Deterministic when created_at is injected (no RNG — same rule + same traces ⇒ same report).

replay_report_id.description: content-addressed id over (rule_candidate_id + sorted evaluated_trace_ids + outcomes); deterministic

rule_class.description: sets which thresholds the gate applies

traces_evaluated.description: number of verified traces the rule was replayed over

true_positives.description: rule decided AND matched the verified decision

false_positives.description: rule decided but DISAGREED with the verified decision (any wrong served decision)

true_negatives.description: rule correctly abstained where it should have

false_negatives.description: rule abstained where it could have correctly decided (lower coverage, not a safety risk)

abstentions.description: number of traces the rule abstained on (deferred to fallback)

precision.description: tp / (tp + fp); the bar the gate checks against the rule_class threshold

unsafe_false_positives.description: false positives that produced a WRONG SERVED FACT (e.g. served FAQ-30 as truth, dropped a source handle); MUST be 0 for a truth_serving promotion

tenant_leak_count.description: cases where the rule decided a global case using a tenant_private trace; MUST be 0 always (gate blocks otherwise)

replayed_over_verified_only.description: structurally pinned true: replay never scores against unverified/reversed/stale traces

evaluated_trace_ids.description: the verified trace ids replayed (lossless link to the evidence set)

unsafe_example_trace_ids.description: trace ids of the unsafe_false_positives, if any; present even if empty so a non-zero count is auditable
